critical_steps: Two coordinate g-frame families on ell2 are identical Parseval and alternate dual.
Local singleton vectors 1/j and j are alternate dual frames for each coefficient space.
Induced vectors e_j/j have no lower frame bound, while j e_j have no Bessel bound and fail to analyze (1/j) into ell2.
Local reconstruction gives Q=identity, so bounded Q alone cannot repair global Besselness.
Uniform local upper bounds for both families yield global Bessel estimates and a valid duality equivalence; diagonal seminormalization is necessary and sufficient in the coordinate model.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact infinite-dimensional coordinate construction, unbounded induced Bessel energies, and bounded operator proof under uniform local Bessel bounds.
integrity.unproved_limits: No necessity is claimed for uniform local upper bounds across general redundant nonorthogonal g-frame families.

limitations: The disproof addresses Corollary 6.2 under its printed hypotheses; a tacit inherited uniform-bound condition would be a different, valid statement.
Uniform upper bounds of both local frame families are a sufficient general repair already compatible with the preceding Theorem 6.1.
The uniform-seminormalization equivalence is asserted precisely for the diagonal singleton scalar model, not arbitrary nonorthogonal g-frame systems.

title: Pointwise alternate duals need not induce global dual frames
